title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Gains Connection Count Policy
summary: AlloyDB v1beta now introduces a new autoscaling policy type based on connection count. You can configure your autoscaler to scale instances based on a target number of connections.
details: Developers can now define autoscaling policies for AlloyDB instances using connection load as a metric. The `Policy` schema has been extended with an optional `connectionsCount` property. This new property references the `ConnectionsCount` schema, which includes a `targetCount` field. This allows you to specify the desired number of connections the autoscaler should aim for, providing more granular control over scaling behavior in response to client load.
